## Public API — OpenAI-Compatible, No Auth Required

Endpoint: https://primals.eco/v1/chat/completions
Models: https://primals.eco/v1/models
Catalog: https://primals.eco/data/neural-catalog.json
Protocol: OpenAI-compatible (POST JSON)

## Example

```
curl -X POST https://primals.eco/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"tinyllama","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```
